items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Max and I on the strength of that, have been very good friends since.

ctx.x: Oh, no doubt about it, and Max and I on the strength of that, have been very good friends since. I ran into him in Italy a couple of years ago. Nice guy.

Oh, I am glad to hear that. And the one thing I wanted to bring out about Davey. Davey's concept was the same as Chick's or people like that, you know. His concept was that drums were the heart of the band. The heart of the band. Correct?
